A [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Tribes Audio Description" /> [[Tusken Raider]] served as the '''craftsman''' of [[gaderffii stick]]s for a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of Tuskens in the [[Dune Sea]] of [[Tatooine]]. He guided individuals in the making of sticks after they had proved themselves worthy of the [[Melee weapon|weapon]]. He operated in an [[Gaderffii stick workshop|open-air workshop]] that sat in the shade of an old [[Starship|shipwreck]].<ref name="Tribes of Tatooine" />

In [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Flashback Chap 2 Date">{{InsiderCite|225|A Certain Point of View (department)}} states that flashback events of "[[Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine]]" took place five [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], corresponding to [[5 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> he taught [[Boba Fett]] in the ways of gaffi crafting after the former [[bounty hunter]] had proven his loyalty to the tribe. The Tusken watched over Fett as he carefully crafted his weapon from the [[Wood|branch]] of a [[Wortwood tree]]. Under the craftsman's watchful [[eye]], Fett constructed his own gaderffii stick that received the approval of a [[Tusken warrior|skilled warrior]] of the tribe. While constructing the gaderffii stick, he used a [[Tusken Adze]].<ref name="Tribes of Tatooine" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The craftsman appeared in "[[Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine]]," the second episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''. The episode was directed by [[Steph Green]]<ref name="Tribes of Tatooine" /> and aired on [[January 5]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release date">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}}</ref>
